text: alex: Noticed weird cross-tenant rows in Insights this morning. Quick thread to collect repro + rollback plan. maria: saw that too — alerts at 06:12 UTC, telemetry shows panel_id=42 had rows from tenant B while user in tenant A. sam: any idea how it's getting prefetched? quick-switch prefetch is on canary for 80% traffic. jin: hypothesis: prefetch cache key missing workspace/org id when a header is rewritten. i saw the header-normalizer change in last rollout. alex: i pulled edge logs. snippet: "GET /api/insights/42?quick=1" had X-Org: 123 and X-Org was dropped before cache key regen. maria: can you paste the log lines? alex: logs: edge-req 2026-03-21T06:11:59Z id=abcd route=preview prefetch_key=preview::insights:42:quick service-proxy 2026-03-21T06:12:00Z id=abcd headers="X-Org: 456" sam: that 456 is wrong. looks like route affinity cookie from previous session. jin: i traced the normalizer change — it moved header strip to earlier middleware to reduce payload size. that might be premature. maria: reproduction steps? alex: steps: 1) login as org A in browser 1 2) open insights panel (prefetch warms cache) 3) login as org B in browser 2, quickly use quick-switch to org B in same session 4) refresh panel in browser1 -> sees org B rows sam: ok can reproduce locally with those steps. probably cache key missing org id when prefetch populates. jin: quick fix: make cache key include Authorization/X-Org at prefetch and ensure header-normalizer runs after cache decision. i'll draft PR. alex: can we rollback the prefetch canary to 0% until fix? maria: yes pls. i'll open rollout rollback and notify SRE. deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for feature=quick-prefetch to 0% by maria — ETA ~2m qa-bot: added repro script to CI (prefetch-isolation-check) and failing on current canary. tagging sam to review. sam: i'll review PR tonight. also propose adding a telemetry gauge for "prefetch-org-mismatch" that increments when cache hit but header org differs. maria: good idea. create ticket with priority P0? we should also scan logs for any leaked PII. alex: low chance PII leaked; it's mostly row-level ids. still, run a log scan. sam: i'll run a grep over last 24h and paste results. alex: thanks. small heads-up: we'll need a postmortem if this went to customers. keep notes here. maria: noted. I'll coordinate comms if postmortem needed. jin: PR link WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — changing header-normalizer order + include org in prefetch key. sam: LGTM on initial diff. add unit test coverage for cache key canonicalization. alex: also add a job to invalidate any prefetch cache entries from the last 24h to be safe. maria: rollback complete. deploy-bot: Canary rollback finished for feature=quick-prefetch — 0% traffic. deploy-bot: Re-deploying service-proxy with normalizer-order hotfix to canary. alex: thanks everyone. we'll sync tomorrow 10am for postmortem prep. sam: :thumbsup: jin: :pray: qa-bot: repro CI job failing -> passing on patched branch. tagging for merge.
